title: SANSKRITI: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models’ Knowledge of Indian Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on a multiple-choice question benchmark (SANSKRITI) covering 16 distinct Indian cultural attributes (e.g., rituals, cuisine, art, history) to measure cultural comprehension and identify knowledge gaps or misrepresentations.

Comparing model accuracy across questions specific to 28 Indian states and 8 union territories to identify performance disparities between globally recognized regions (e.g., Delhi, Maharashtra) and underrepresented regions (e.g., North-Eastern states).
